name: agy-pixel-buddy
description: Animated pixel character buddy that reacts in real time when Antigravity AI is thinking, coding, reading, or running commands.

commands.title: Agy Pixel Buddy: Focus Buddy View
Agy Pixel Buddy: Toggle Floating Buddy

agyPixelBuddy.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before an active state falls back to idle if no new hook event arrives.

agyPixelBuddy.statusFile.description: Optional custom path to buddy-state.json. Leave empty to use ~/.gemini/antigravity/buddy-state.json.

agyPixelBuddy.floatingMode.description: Floating buddy behavior inside the Antigravity IDE window: random (roam inside IDE), sticky (stay where placed in IDE), or hidden (disabled).

agyPixelBuddy.language.description: UI and status bubble language (id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English).

agyPixelBuddy.promptReaction.description: Enable/disable reaction animation (petting for cat, comedic whip crack for bot and dev).

agyPixelBuddy.reactionTrigger.description: When to trigger reaction animation: hook (every hook change) or prompt (new prompt only).

agyPixelBuddy.trainer.description: Human character who pets (cat) or whips (bot/dev) during reaction animations.
